prompt:
Use the table in the image. It shows a zebra-striped table with one Name column, several numeric columns, alternating row shading, and a shaded header row. Use the table values to evaluate the queried cell expression. Read the two cell values at (Hong, Temp) and (Jed, Pts) and report their absolute difference.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly two bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] in the same order as the two queried cells.
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact requested integer result.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236]],"answer":6}
